mission: Make the existing Floppy architecture operate more deterministically, consistently, and efficiently while preserving Human-in-the-Loop authority.
controlling_principle: Human decisions stay human. Deterministic consequences of accepted human decisions should be bundled, applied consistently, and validated as atomic transactions.

design_laws.name: Repository State Remains Recoverable Without a Runtime
Context Loss Is Not Authority to Reconstruct Accepted Work

administrator_local_environment.worktree_rule: Use the exact repository-recorded V3 worktree once lawfully established; do not invent a V3 worktree path.
administrator_local_environment.transfer_artifact_rule: Administrator-transfer scripts and artifacts use the fixed Downloads directory unless explicitly changed by the administrator.

sections.name: Architecture and Compatibility Contract
sections.purpose: Freeze the V3 design laws, V2 compatibility boundary, authority classifications, repository/runtime boundary, versioning rules, and migration boundary before implementation proceeds.
sections.terminal_outcome: Stable architecture and compatibility definitions on which V3-02 through V3-09 can rely.

sections.name: Terminal Delivery Contract
sections.purpose: Ensure implementation, verification, acceptance, closeout, integration, release, and final-closure obligations always have a defined responsible role and handoff.
sections.terminal_outcome: No required terminal delivery obligation can become orphaned between roles.

sections.name: Role Capability Contracts
sections.purpose: Formalize the read, reason, recommend, prepare, verify, write, commit, transaction, acceptance, authorization, release, succession, and prohibited capabilities of each Floppy role.
sections.terminal_outcome: Role authority and technical capability are explicitly separated and cross-role authority inheritance is testable.

sections.name: Deterministic Context and Retrieval Profile
sections.purpose: Define repository-native Level 0 through Level 3 bounded context selection, read order, expansion rules, stale-record rejection, and accepted-state precedence without requiring permanent runtime or RAG infrastructure.
sections.terminal_outcome: Fresh compatible models can reconstruct substantially the same required context and authority state from the same repository state.

sections.name: Project Orchestrator Succession V3
sections.purpose: Make Project Orchestrator replacement deterministic, repository-backed, checkpoint-bound, Continuity-Overseer-verified, and low-friction while keeping succession acceptance human-controlled.
sections.terminal_outcome: Validated succession bundles preserve accepted state, authority fingerprint, unresolved work, and terminal obligations across Orchestrator lifetimes.

sections.name: Human-Authority Transaction Bundles
sections.purpose: Implement atomic deterministic consequence bundles for accepted human decisions, including authorization, acceptance, closeout, version, succession, and release-preparation transactions.
sections.terminal_outcome: Human decisions remain discrete while their defined mechanical consequences apply coherently or fail atomically.

sections.name: floppyctl status and Project-State Inspection
sections.purpose: Provide canonical human-readable and JSON project-state inspection derived from repository authority, including current roles, lifecycle, authorization, blockers, terminal owner, and next lawful operation.
sections.terminal_outcome: Humans and models can obtain one authoritative project status surface without manually reconstructing many records.

sections.name: Release Automation and Consistency Validation
sections.purpose: Build deterministic release packages and a release-readiness manifest while validating consistency across version, documentation, manifests, compatibility metadata, packages, checksums, notes, and intended tag/commit.
sections.terminal_outcome: Release preparation detects stale or contradictory public/product state before publication while leaving release approval human-controlled.

sections.name: Integration, Compatibility, Documentation, Packaging, and V3 Release
sections.purpose: Own complete terminal V3 delivery from accepted V3-01 through V3-08 results through integration, compatibility validation, documentation reconciliation, packaging, administrator release decision, v3.0.0 publication, and final V3 closure.
sections.terminal_outcome: v3.0.0 is verified, published, packaged, and V3 is finally closed with V3-10 NONEXISTENT_NOT_AUTHORIZED.

human_decisions: material architecture, security, or cost decision
deterministic_consequences: inactive next-section draft generation after accepted closeout
